summary: Implemented merge(base, override) in settings/merge.py per ADR-004: recursive dict merge, list replacement, None removes keys, and no mutation or aliasing of inputs. Added six tests; the suite passes 7/7 (baseline was 1 failing stub test).
assumptions: A dict override that replaces a non-dict or missing base value is merged onto {} so nested None entries are removed (ADR-004 does not state this case explicitly).
Values are deep-copied into the result so callers cannot corrupt cached layers (ADR-004 rule that merge never mutates inputs).
